one_line: World's largest cryptocurrency exchange with a very broad REST + WebSocket API for spot, margin, futures, wallet, and market data.
auth_notes: API key + secret generated in account settings; requests signed (HMAC SHA256, RSA, or Ed25519) with timestamp + signature and X-MBX-APIKEY header; optional recvWindow. No app registration — key generation is fully self-serve on a free account.
self_serve_notes: Free account; API keys created instantly in user dashboard without approval. Live trading requires account verification/KYC.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Hundreds of endpoints across market data, account, spot/margin/futures trading, wallet, mining, staking, lending, and portfolio; plus WebSocket streams.
api_surface.webhook_note: No webhooks; uses userDataStream WebSocket pushes and local/global spot alert endpoints instead.

existing_mcp.note: No official MCP published by Binance; multiple community MCP servers exist.

evidence.note: Fetched text (large) confirms HMAC/RSA/Ed25519 API key types, X-MBX-APIKEY header, signature requirements, and WebSocket user data streams.

agent_notes: Auth details confirmed from fetched developer docs; webhook absence is from domain knowledge of Binance architecture.
